conventions.j: radiance per metre, including normalized per-steradian phase
conventions.preExposure: explicit scale of S and input/background radiance once; T unchanged

independentOracles: Simpson quadrature of attenuated source along ray
Solid-angle Simpson quadrature of actual HG g=.32/.76 and Rayleigh
limits: Homogeneous segment/source coefficients; no heterogeneous quadrature policy or production ray partition yet.
Single-scattering source algebra, not multiple scattering or a full volumetric solver.
No inversion/division of an already rendered air background, no Gaussian state/column duplicate.
GLSL is shared source with validated-input contract; actual WebGL compilation/precision/FP16 overflow need separate GPU checks.
No production visuals, cloud illumination, persistent-smoke integration or performance acceptance implied.

checks.name: zero geometric length is exact identity even with finite nonzero beta/j
vacuum and black source preserve any nonnegative background
zero extinction has stable j*length without an artificial epsilon
pure absorption agrees with Beer transmittance and cannot create light
tiny optical depths and both sides of polynomial boundary retain double precision
strong extinction including finite-input optical-depth overflow stays finite
subnormal beta does not erase a representable integrated source
48 seeded RGB spectra agree with independent RK4 transport ODE
source integral independently agrees with Simpson quadrature
nonuniform geometric subdivision is invariant at fixed coefficients
front/back ordering matches the independently integrated piecewise ray
serial composition is not commutative for different illuminated layers
composition is associative, including a zero-transmission foreground
co-spatial air+smoke adds beta and source before one integration
co-spatial addition is order invariant and zero media is neutral
multiple lamps add j without adding the same medium extinction twice
SSA zero/one and RGB fractions constrain scattering by extinction
HG actual g=.32 and .76 integrate to one over solid angle
HG isotropic and negative-g profiles are normalized, not clamped to forward
HG phaseMax is an all-direction bound for actual and strongly anisotropic g
HG forward/back ratio independently matches (1+g)^3/(1-g)^3
Rayleigh phase integrates to one and has its correct endpoint maximum
propagation convention distinguishes physical forward and back scattering
source units contain sigma_s*irradiance*phase and no extra Lambert factor
integrated scattering obeys SSA/phaseMax/incident bound without summing puffs blindly
storage P scales S and background once while T stays dimensionless
serial and co-spatial composition commute with a consistent single storage scale
public inputs reject NaN/Infinity/negative beta,j,length and malformed RGB
SSA/g/cosine domains and zero direction fail instead of being silently sanitized
invalid transfer coefficients and unrepresentable radiance throw, never clamp
functions accept typed RGB arrays without mutating inputs or aliasing outputs
RGB T stays in [0,1], S>=0, and total intensity is monotone in independent sources
shared GLSL exposes homologous highp segment/phase/algebra without samplers or automatic exposure

detail.scope: structural CPU/GLSL contract only; not a shader compile or GPU precision claim
